llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光冲击强化和热处理对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V合金摩擦学性能的优化，直接涉及后处理对力学性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on tribological (wear) properties rather than fatigue or tensile performance, which are the primary mechanical properties emphasized in the direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 为提高L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V合金的耐磨性能，探索联合后处理工艺。
summary_zh.method: 结合激光冲击强化和热处理对试样进行表面改性。
summary_zh.result: 联合处理显著改善了摩擦学性能，降低了磨损率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过摩擦磨损试验验证了优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the wear resistance of laser powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V alloy by optimizing post-processing treatments.
summary_en.method: Combined laser shock peening and heat treatment were applied to modify the surface properties of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The combined treatment significantly enhanced tribological performance, reducing wear rate.
summary_en.validation: Tribological tests (e.g., pin-on-disc) were conducted to validate the improvement.

papers.title: The Impact of Columnar and Equiaxed β-Grain Structures on Mechanical Anisotropy in High-Deposition-Rate Additively Manufactured α + β Titanium Alloys
papers.abstract: Abstract There is growing interest to produce α + β titanium alloys with high-deposition-rate additive manufacturing (DED-AM) processes for aerospace applications. However, there are still important aspects of their microstructure-mechanical property relationships that are not well understood, which are linked to the macro and microstructure heterogeneities generated by the AM processes and intrinsic titanium metallurgy that produce columnar β -grain structures. Trends in the literature, which are based primarily on Ti-6Al-4V data, have shown mechanical anisotropy is often present when samples exhibit coarse and columnar β -grain structures. This includes yield-stress and elongation anisotropy arising during uniaxial tensile testing, and crack growth rate anisotropy with high scatter recorded during fatigue testing, both of which are generally only tested in orientations parallel and perpendicular to the AM build direction. In this work, this mechanical anisotropy in α + β titanium alloys is investigated in more detail with Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo-0.1Si wire-arc additively manufactured test samples, comparing columnar parent β -grain structures to equiaxed grain structures. In particular, highlighting that the true yield-stress anisotropy in columnar grain samples is only revealed when testing the material at a 45 deg orientation away from the AM build direction. It is also shown that the large grain boundary α colonies that form on parent columnar β -grain boundaries have a significant impact on the fatigue crack growth rate data scatter. Refining the parent β -grain structures is demonstrated to resolve these issues and the related microstructure mechanisms were investigated in detail, using both experimental and crystal plasticity simulation methods. Finally, the formation and three dimensionality of the detrimental grain boundary α colonies that nucleate on columnar β -grain boundaries were investigated for the first time using in-situ SEM heating and 3D-EBSD techniques.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学各向异性和疲劳裂纹扩展行为，与L1方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper directly addresses mechanical anisotropy and fatigue crack growth in as-built Ti-6Al-4V; it does not cover post-processing or implant-specific contexts, which are out of scope for this direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高沉积速率增材制造α+β钛合金中柱状和等轴β晶粒结构对力学各向异性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过线弧增材制造制备Ti-6Al-4V试样，进行多取向拉伸和疲劳试验，结合晶体塑性模拟。
summary_zh.result: 柱状晶粒在45°方向显示真实屈服各向异性，粗晶界α相增加疲劳裂纹扩展数据分散性，细化β晶粒可改善。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸试验和疲劳裂纹扩展试验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the impact of columnar versus equiaxed β-grain structures on mechanical anisotropy in high-deposition-rate additively manufactured α+β titanium alloys.
summary_en.method: Wire-arc additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo-0.1Si specimens, tensile and fatigue testing at multiple orientations, combined with crystal plasticity simulations.
summary_en.result: True yield-stress anisotropy in columnar grain samples is revealed at 45° orientation, and large grain boundary α colonies on columnar β-grain boundaries significantly increase fatigue crack growth rate scatter; refining β-grains resolves these issues.
summary_en.validation: Uniaxial tensile tests and fatigue crack growth tests.

papers.title: The Low-Cycle Fatigue Performance of Emerging Titanium Alloys for Aeroengine Applications
papers.abstract: The low-cycle fatigue behavior of three titanium alloys (including two wrought alloys that are commercially available and one under development via a powder sintering technique) is described in order to assess the relative capabilities of a fourth, novel proprietary alloy, designated as RR11. Despite relatively increased levels of beta stabilization, each alloy remains within the general alpha–beta microstructural category and could be considered as an engineering alternative to the well-established Ti-6Al-4V. The relationships between fatigue behavior, microstructure, grain morphology, micro-texture, and alloy chemistry are explored. Emphasis is placed upon the potential cold dwell fatigue sensitivity of the four alternative alloys, which is particularly pertinent since it was recognized that Ti-6Al-4V can suffer from cold dwell-related behavior subject to selected thermo-mechanical processing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究其他钛合金的低周疲劳性能，仅将Ti-6Al-4V作为对比，不涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not study additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on wrought and powder-sintered alloys with only a comparative reference to Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估替代钛合金相对于Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，用于航空发动机。
summary_zh.method: 对三种锻造和一种粉末烧结合金进行低周疲劳测试和微观结构表征。
summary_zh.result: 新型合金RR11表现出与现有合金相当的疲劳行为，但所有合金均存在冷蠕变疲劳敏感性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观分析验证疲劳行为。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to evaluate the low-cycle fatigue performance of alternative titanium alloys relative to Ti-6Al-4V for aeroengine applications.
summary_en.method: Low-cycle fatigue tests and microstructural characterization were conducted on three wrought alloys and one powder-sintered alloy.
summary_en.result: The novel RR11 alloy exhibits comparable fatigue behavior to existing alloys, but all alloys display cold dwell fatigue sensitivity.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical fatigue testing combined with microstructural analysis.
